# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 4 tokens; Lines — 5 tokens; Text — 3 tokens; Accent, primary and focus — 8 tokens; Status — 4 tokens; Review — 3 tokens; Danger — 3 tokens; Label colours — 7 tokens; Overlay — 1 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 7 tokens; Radius — 3 tokens; Size — 22 tokens; Shadow — 2 tokens; Opacity — 2 tokens; Motion — 5 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* light theme: the token’s name, with its light value as the fallback */
color: var(--bg, #f4f5f7);
/* dark theme: put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take the fallback from the dark column */
color: var(--bg, #15171a);
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--bg` | #f4f5f7 | #15171a | App ground: board, header, status bar. |
| `--surface` | #ffffff | #1d2024 | Cards, reader page, editor, inputs, menus and modals. |
| `--surface-hover` | #e9ebef | #262a2f | Hover fill for edgeless buttons, crumbs, menu rows and card actions, on bg or surface (light: 1.11:1 on bg, 1.22:1 on surface; dark: 1.24:1 on bg, 1.13:1 on surface). Fades in over motion-hover. |
| `--surface-sunken` | #eceef2 | #111316 | Inline code, key caps, neutral label pills, the empty-column well, editor gutter. |

## Color · Lines

### Use

```css
/* light theme: the token’s name, with its light value as the fallback */
color: var(--line, #cfd4db);
/* dark theme: put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take the fallback from the dark column */
color: var(--line, #353a42);
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--line` | #cfd4db | #353a42 | Dividers only: header and status bar rules, modal head and foot rules, the sheet's rules, a modal frame's edge. Decorative, never the edge of a control or a card. |
| `--line-soft` | #dfe2e7 | #2d3138 | Card edges at rest; hairline of secondary buttons in modal feet and dialogs. Decorative. |
| `--line-strong` | #7c8491 | #737c89 | Only edges that identify a control: text fields, Selects, checkboxes, radios, a ghost tile's dashed edge; plus, under the pointer, a card, an Agenda day, the Reader's edit outline and a pane divider. 3.2:1 or better on every surface in both themes (WCAG 1.4.11). Text buttons, labels and key caps have no line-strong edge. |
| `--scrollbar` | #bfc4cb | #737c89 | Scrollbar thumb while scrolling. Hidden at rest: no thumb until the pane scrolls or the pointer reaches its edge. Light 1.75:1 on surface, dark 3.9:1. |
| `--scrollbar-active` | #a1a7b0 | #a7aeb9 | Scrollbar thumb under the pointer (8pt). Light 2.4:1 on surface; dark matches ink-muted. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* light theme: the token’s name, with its light value as the fallback */
color: var(--ink, #15181d);
/* dark theme: put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take the fallback from the dark column */
color: var(--ink, #e7e9ec);
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #15181d | #e7e9ec | Primary text on bg, surface, surface-hover, surface-sunken. |
| `--ink-muted` | #4d5562 | #a7aeb9 | Secondary text: summaries, paths, counts, dates, word counts, the status bar, modal context. At least 6.4:1 on all surfaces. |
| `--ink-faint` | #626a78 | #8c939e | Placeholders, separators, empty-state text, menu key caps. At least 4.5:1 on all surfaces; never smaller than 11px. |

## Color · Accent, primary and focus

### Use

```css
/* light theme: the token’s name, with its light value as the fallback */
color: var(--accent, #2b54c4);
/* dark theme: put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take the fallback from the dark column */
color: var(--accent, #86a4ff);
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--accent` | #2b54c4 | #86a4ff | On a control, blue means selected, focused or a link: selected card, focus ring, links, active filter, dragging scrollbar. Beyond controls, the data colour: charts, the Agenda's ramp, the build line. Not a button fill (see primary). |
| `--accent-soft` | #e4eafb | #222c47 | Selected card fill, text selection, active crumb. |
| `--on-accent` | #ffffff | #0b1433 | Text and icons on an accent fill (checked checkbox, and the primary button if primary is switched back to accent). |
| `--primary` | {ink} → #15181d | {ink} → #e7e9ec | Fill of the one filled button per screen (New issue, Save, Add to Todo). An ink fill, so blue stays for selection and focus. Alternative kept for comparison: set to {accent} with on-primary {on-accent}. |
| `--primary-hover` | #2e333b | #c9cdd3 | Primary under the pointer. |
| `--on-primary` | #ffffff | #15171a | Label on primary. |
| `--focus` | {accent} → #2b54c4 | {accent} → #86a4ff | 2px keyboard focus ring on every focusable element. |
| `--focus-halo` | rgba(43,84,196,0.20) | rgba(134,164,255,0.26) | Soft 3px glow around a focused text field, textarea, composer or editor, outside its single focus-coloured border. Never a second ring. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable.

### Use

```css
font: 600 15px/20px "Inter", -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, sans-serif;
font: var(--text-ui-title);
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-title` | `.ui-title`, `--text-ui-title` | 15px / 20px | 600 | `sans` | Project name in the header, modal titles. |
| `ui-body` | `.ui-body`, `--text-ui-body` | 13px / 18px | 400 | `sans` | Default UI text, inputs, card titles (at 500). |
| `ui-strong` | `.ui-strong`, `--text-ui-strong` | 13px / 18px | 500 | `sans` | Card title, column titles (title case), current crumb, button labels at 12px. |
| `ui-small` | `.ui-small`, `--text-ui-small` | 12px / 17px | 400 | `sans` | Card summary, review findings. |
| `ui-label` | `.ui-label`, `--text-ui-label` | 11px / 14px, letter-spacing 0.06em | 600 | `sans` | Uppercase section labels (Not written yet). Column titles use ui-strong in title case. |
| `meta` | `.meta`, `--text-meta` | 12px / 16px | 400 | `sans` | Inter, ink-muted: paths, file names, counts, dates, word counts, the status bar, modal context (in todo/, named in the background, Saved for this session). |
| `read-h1` | `.read-h1`, `--text-read-h1` | 20px / 26px | 600 | `sans` | Issue title in the reader. |
| `read-h2` | `.read-h2`, `--text-read-h2` | 16px / 22px | 600 | `sans` | ## headings in the reader. 24pt above, 6pt below. |
| `read-h3` | `.read-h3`, `--text-read-h3` | 14px / 20px | 600 | `sans` | ### headings and deeper in the reader. 16pt above, 4pt below. |
| `read-body` | `.read-body`, `--text-read-body` | 15px / 24px | 400 | `sans` | Rendered markdown paragraphs and lists, in a read-measure (560pt, about 75 characters) column. |
| `edit-body` | `.edit-body`, `--text-edit-body` | 13px / 20px | 400 | `mono` | The plain-text editor, code blocks and diffs. |
| `meta-mono` | `.meta-mono`, `--text-meta-mono` | 11px / 14px | 500 | `mono` | JetBrains Mono: key caps only (Kbd, key hints in buttons, menus and tooltips). |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"Inter", -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"JetBrains Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: var(--space-1); elsewhere its value from the table */
```

### Tokens (7)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 2px | Icon to label nudges, kbd padding. |
| `--space-2` | 4px | Gap between labels, icon to text in pills. |
| `--space-3` | 8px | Gap between cards, between a card's rows (labels, title, summary), between header controls. |
| `--space-4` | 12px | Card horizontal padding, review row padding. |
| `--space-5` | 16px | Window gutter, column gap. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Reader page vertical padding. |
| `--space-7` | 32px | Reader page horizontal padding. |

## Size

Fixed control heights, in points. Compact but at least 22pt to stay clickable on a trackpad.

### Use

```css
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: var(--control-h); elsewhere its value from the table */
```

### Tokens (22)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--control-h` | 24px | Buttons, filter input, checkbox row. |
| `--status-icon` | 14px | Column status icon: 14pt box, 1.5pt stroke, in the status colour. |
| `--bar-h` | 40px | Header bar. The traffic lights sit on its centre line (titlebar-light-y). |
| `--statusbar-h` | 24px | Bottom status bar. |
| `--column-min` | 200px | Narrowest column before the board scrolls sideways: four columns fit the 880pt minimum window. |
| `--column-max` | 420px | Widest column; extra width stays empty on the right. |
| `--reader-max` | 624px | Reader and editor sheet width: read-measure plus 32pt padding each side. |
| `--read-measure` | 560px | Text column of the reader at read-body: about 75 characters per line (measured 70 to 79 on prose). |
| `--scroll-thumb` | 4px | Scrollbar thumb width at rest and while scrolling. Overlay: takes no layout width. |
| `--scroll-thumb-hover` | 8px | Scrollbar thumb width under the pointer and while dragging. |
| `--scroll-hit` | 12px | Pointer strip along the pane's edge, wider than the thumb so a trackpad finds it. The pointer entering it reveals a hidden thumb. |
| `--scroll-thumb-min` | 24px | Shortest thumb on a very long page, the same as control-h. |
| `--modal-s` | 360px | Modal S: one question, one action (ConfirmDialog). |
| `--modal-m` | 480px | Modal M: forms and settings (Settings, GroupsDialog). |
| `--modal-l` | 760px | Modal L: one document, a 720pt sheet with 20pt each side. |
| `--modal-xl` | 1200px | Modal XL maximum width; otherwise the window minus modal-inset each side (NewIssueModal, RefinePanel). |
| `--modal-xl-h` | 900px | Modal XL maximum height; XL is always this tall or the window minus the inset, so nothing jumps while content streams in. |
| `--modal-inset` | 32px | Gap kept between the window and a modal: 16 at the sides and bottom under 720pt of window width, but always 32 at the top, below the traffic lights (titlebar-h). |
| `--titlebar-h` | 28px | Top strip the traffic lights occupy (they span 14 to 26 once centred on the bar). No modal frame enters it; the top modal inset never drops below modal-inset. |
| `--titlebar-lead` | 80px | Leading width the traffic lights take in the header bar (three 12pt lights, centres 20, 40, 60). Nothing is drawn or clickable there; the project name or the Board button starts after it. |
| `--titlebar-light-y` | 20px | Centre line of the traffic lights, from the window's top: bar-h / 2. The header's controls and crumbs centre on the same line. |
| `--titlebar-light-x` | 20px | Centre of the close button from the window's left edge; the next two follow every 20pt. |


### Tokens (2)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |

## Motion

Durations; with reduced motion every one is 0 (state changes in one frame).

### Use

```css
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: var(--motion-hover); elsewhere its value from the table */
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--motion-hover` | 100ms | Hover fills fading in (buttons, crumbs, menu rows, card actions, card edge). Fading out is instant. Keyboard selection never animates. |
| `--motion-hint` | 120ms | Key hints sliding out beside their control when ⌘ is held, and back. |
| `--hint-hold` | 500ms | How long ⌘ alone must be held before key hints show. Any other key, or letting go, cancels and hides them. |
| `--scroll-linger` | 800ms | How long a scrollbar stays after the last scroll movement, or after the pointer leaves the edge strip. |
| `--scroll-fade` | 150ms | Scrollbar thumb fading in and out. |
